search_text: published ZDI-23-497 ZDI-CAN-19608 (Pwn2Own) NETGEAR RAX30 GetInfo Missing Authentication Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2023-05-01 CVE-2023-27357 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-27357 6.5 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N ['NETGEAR'] ['RAX30'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of NETGEAR RAX30 routers. title: (Pwn2Own) NETGEAR RAX30 GetInfo Missing Authentication Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of NETGEAR RAX30 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of SOAP requests. The issue results from the lack of authentication prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose sensitive information, leading to further compromise.
